# Miqsat Ma'ase Ha-Torah Section 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 4QMMT (4Q394–399, Cave 4), Section A continued + beginning of B | **Condition:** Fragmentary; reconstructed from multiple manuscripts

---

**2:1** [...the Festival of-Weeks...] on the fifteenth of-the-[third]-month [...] after the sabbath [...]

**2:2** [...] you-shall-count seven complete sabbaths from the day of-your-bringing the sheaf of-the-wave-offering [...]

**2:3** [...] on the morrow of-the-seventh sabbath you-shall-count [fifty days] and-you-shall-bring a new grain-offering to-the-LORD.

**2:4** [...] the Festival of-First-Fruits [...] bread of-the-first-fruits [...]

**2:5** The Festival of-New-Wine: on the third of-the-[fifth]-month after the sabbath [...] you-shall-count from the day of-the-Festival-of-Weeks [...]

**2:6** [...] seven sabbaths and-two days [...] and-you-shall-offer new wine upon the altar [...]

**2:7** [...] the first-fruits of-the-wine [...] the priests shall-dash the blood upon the altar [...]

**2:8** [...] the tithe of-the-wine [...] the Levites [...]

**2:9** [...] the Festival of-New-Oil [...] after the [Festival of-New]-Wine [...]

**2:10** The Festival of-New-Oil: on the twenty-second of-the-sixth-month [...] after the sabbath [...]

**2:11** [...] you-shall-count from the day of-the-Festival-of-[New]-Wine seven sabbaths and-two days [...]

**2:12** [...] and-you-shall-offer new oil upon the altar [...] the first-fruits of-the-oil [...]

**2:13** [...] an offering by-fire [...] a pleasing aroma to-the-LORD [...]

**2:14** [...] the Day of-Wood-Offering [...] after the oil [...] the tribes [...]

**2:15** The Day of-Wood-Offering: the leaders of-the-tribes [...] shall-bring the wood for-the-altar [...]

**2:16** [...] the tribe of-Levi first [...] the tribe of-Judah [...] the tribe of-Benjamin [...]

**2:17** [...] the tribe of-the-sons-of-Joseph: Ephraim and-Manasseh [...]

**2:18** [...] the tribe of-Reuben [...] the tribe of-Simeon [...] and-Issachar [...]

**2:19** [...] on the twenty-third of-the-sixth-month [...] after the Festival-of-New-Oil [...]

**2:20** And-concerning [...] these are some of-our-rulings [...] concerning [...]

**2:21** [...] some of-the-works of-the-Torah which we consider for-your-good and-for-the-good of-your-people [...]

**2:22** [...] for we saw in-you wisdom and-knowledge of-the-Torah [...]

**2:23** Consider [...] and-ask from-Him that-He-straighten your counsel [...]

**2:24** [...] and-keep far from-you the evil scheming and-the-counsel of-Belial [...]

**2:25** [...] these are some of-the-things concerning which we-have-written to-you [...]

---

*EMET notes: This section completes the calendar (Section A) and transitions into the halakhic letter (Section B). The Festival of Weeks (Shavu'ot) is calculated by counting seven complete sabbaths from the wave-offering — following the sectarian 364-day solar calendar rather than the Pharisaic reckoning. The Festival of New Wine and Festival of New Oil are unique to this calendar, unattested in the Hebrew Bible. The Day of Wood Offering assigns tribal rotation for supplying altar wood. The opening of Section B ("these are some of our rulings") provides the document's title: Miqsat Ma'ase Ha-Torah ("some of the works of the Torah"). Hyphenated forms preserve construct chains.*
